title: blob-server: serve RFC 9404 urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob (Blob/upload, 9404 Blob/get and Blob/lookup)
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B11. Crates: jmap-blob-types, jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Per docs/design/DECISIONS.md decision 11 and docs/design/blobext.md §2 (RFC 9404 table), §4 (rfc9404 types), §5 ('Mode switch', 'Blob/get' step 7, 'Blob/upload', 'Blob/lookup'), spec /data/PROJECT/IETF/specs/rfc9404.txt §3.1, §4.1-§4.3 and blobext-03 §2.1. blob-types rfc9404.rs: BlobUploadArgs, UploadObject, BlobUploadCallResponse (accountId/created/notCreated). blob-server: upload.rs handle_blob_upload registered by register_blob_handlers (accountId and create required; non-empty update/destroy -> invalidArguments; each entry through set::create_one with no size/digest and no_persist false; created id/type/size/expires never omitted so every upload reaches createdIds); get.rs Rfc9404 mode (null properties -> data+size even with offset/length; chunks/imageData -> invalidArguments; dataSourceProperties ignored); lookup.rs Rfc9404 mode identical, unknown blob -> empty arrays with no notFound. Rulings follow blobext.md §12 Q3 (i)-(l). Acceptance: tests/rfc9404.rs per blobext.md §10 'server, RFC 9404 mode': §4.1.1, §4.1.2 ('How quick was that?', size 19), §4.2.1, §4.2.2 G1-G5 (assert requested types, not the example's swapped ones), §4.3.1 with the empty-array row; both URIs -> invalidArguments from all five methods; public-api snapshot and CHANGELOG updated.
